messages:
Ravi: Quick poll  microwave soundtrack for popcorn: playlist or silence? I vote playlist. :popcorn: :musical_note:
Noelle: Playlist please. Silence is the sound of passive-aggression from whoever microwaves fish. :sweat_smile:
Eli: Ill DJ. Bringing 3-minute timer bangers. Also starting a tiny haiku-off while we wait. 4-line micro-poems only (for chaos).
Zara: Rules? Must be food-themed and not exceed 4 lines. Winner gets to rename SnackBot for a day.
SnackBot: kitchen-bot: Microwave available. Estimated queue: 1. Please remove items promptly.
Kim: I nominate "Microwave Maestro" for Eli's playlist name. Also I have a haiku:
Kim: Popcorn percussion
Kim: kernels clap, butter rains
Kim: office applause
Kim: lunchtime symphony
Theo: This is peak office culture. Voting emoji after each poem: :heart: for love it, :laughing: for silly, :clap: for chef's kiss.
Maya: My entry (very short):
Maya: Midnight ramen hum
Maya: steam writes haikus on lids
Maya: chair turns into drum
Maya: spoon conducts the night
Ravi: Eli's playlist link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/microwave-bangers (posted for dramatic effect)
Eli: Tiny DJ note: 2-3 minute tracks only. Code to queue (for the nerds):
Eli: ```
queue.addTrack('tiny-banger', start=0, duration<=180)
```
Noelle: Ok poem votes: Kim :heart:, Maya :clap:.
Zara: My poem (last minute):
Zara: pale steam etching
Zara: deadlines blur into butter
Zara: window of three minutes
Zara: popcorn stars emerge
SnackBot: kitchen-bot: Poll created: react with :heart: :laughing: :clap: to vote on latest poem. Ends in 5 minutes.
Theo: Also—tiny rule addendum: if your poem references deadlines you owe someone coffee. Fair warning. :coffee:
Ravi: Love the energy. Whoever wins gets to rename SnackBot for 24 hours. Proposals: "SizzleMaster", "SnackSage", "TimerTyrant".
Maya: Vote for SnackSage. Very presidential.
Eli: Playlist queued, popcorn popping. Microwaves and micro-poems, a balanced ecosystem. :popcorn: :musical_note:
Noelle: Will post pics of the snack shrine. If SnackBot gets renamed to TimerTyrant I will nearly faint. :joy:
